title: Grateful Dead Live at Rose Palace on 1969-05-10
lineage: mC > C > DAT > Sonic Solutions > CDR

ai_review.summary: Soundboard source with generally good sound (aside from late‑night Dark Star noise) and a smoking second half highlighted by an epic Dark Star, The Eleven and Turn On Your Lovelight.
ai_review.review: The recording captures a solid soundboard performance; early tracks are described as filler and suffer occasional power‑outage glitches, but the audio is clear for most of the set. The show shines after the first six songs, delivering a powerful Dark Star that sparkles despite some digital deterioration later on, plus lengthy, inspired renditions of The Eleven and Lovelight.

ai_rating.rationale: Strong musical performance (especially Dark Star, The Eleven, Lovelight) weighted heavily; recording is mostly good with some noted noise and equipment issues, leading to a solid overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear sound for most of the set; digital noise/deterioration appears in the latter part of Dark Star and early equipment problems (power cuts) affect a few tracks, but overall the mix is balanced.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First six songs are considered filler and suffer from power‑outage glitches; momentum builds dramatically with Dark Star, leading into a marathon The Eleven and a soaring Lovelight that define the second half.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia’s playing is highlighted as powerful—his amp turned up loud, his tone “sparkles” on Dark Star and he heats up during Morning Dew.
